news.title: Tavus says nearly half of users thought its AI was human, and that's the unsettling part

bullets: Help run and define company-wide product management.
Own customer outcomes end to end. You'll take ownership of entire customer journeys, everything from first sign-up through to production outcomes, and treat the whole arc as yours.
Earn the respect of the engineering team, not just by speaking their language, but by operating in a way that inspires.
Move extremely fast with a strong bias for execution. You consider yourself a world-class PM. Expectations are high, but so is impact and breadth.
